description: Print the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server URL for consuming a Fabric ontology (preview) item. External MCP clients (VS Code agent mode, Claude, Copilot Studio) connect to this URL over HTTP transport with Fabric auth. The URL is deterministic; fabio constructs it because agents cannot guess the /mcp/dataPlane/.../ontologyEndpoint shape.

data.note: Consume this URL as an MCP server (HTTP transport) from VS Code agent mode, Claude, Copilot Studio, or any MCP client, signing in with your Fabric credentials. Prerequisites: an F2+/P1 capacity and the 'Ontology item (preview)' tenant setting enabled.

notes: The URL shape DIFFERS from the data-agent MCP URL (/mcp/workspaces/{ws}/dataagents/{id}/agent). There is no 'publish' step for ontology — the endpoint is live as soon as the item exists. When the ontology id is not found, the command still emits the deterministic URL but sets exists=false and adds a hint instead of the note. Verified live: an MCP 'initialize' handshake to this URL returns serverInfo 'Microsoft Fabric Ontology' v1.0.0 with a tools capability. This is distinct from grounding a data agent ON an ontology (fabio data-agent add-datasource --artifact-type Ontology).
